summary: 85-foot steel tower erected at Toivola, Saint Louis County, MN, in 1932 per the Forest Lookouts Minnesota list; the FFLA list marks it gone. No source found describes the site today.

facts.status_note: The FFLA Minnesota list marks the tower gone. No source found gives a removal date.

events.note: 85-foot steel tower with exterior ladder erected, per the Forest Lookouts Minnesota list; builder not named

evidence.supports: 85-foot steel tower with exterior ladder erected in 1932
evidence.quote: 1932: An 85-foot steel tower with exterior ladder was erected.

evidence.supports: land-survey location 54N-20W-12 in Saint Louis County
FFLA lists Toivola as a tower, marked gone, at 47.16761 -92.81737

notes_for_editor: Two list entries only. The 1932 build and 85-foot height come from the Forest Lookouts Minnesota list alone; the FFLA list gives only the gone status and coordinates. No builder, reason, staffing or fire record found. Two WebSearch calls and about six page reads used. Two sources name Toivola only as a tower, and a 1920 county history mentions Toivola only as a township name, so neither is used. Story is about 97 words, under the 120-word floor, because the evidence is thin; not padded. The FFLA catalogue PDF linked from firelookout.org was not cached and may hold more.
